title: Evaluation and Optimization of Light Pollution Based on EWM-TOPSIS

context_sources.name: Resource and Environment Science and Data Center
context_sources.role: Night light, GDP, and population rasters

context_sources.name: National Bureau of Statistics of China

limitations: Equations 1 to 23 print as bare numbers; the expressions were stripped in extraction.
The notation table lost its symbols.
One figure caption names strategy 2 where the paragraph discusses strategy 3.
The rebound perturbation's bounds are never given numerically.
Page 25, the flyer, has no text layer and was read from the page image.

tasks: Build an evaluation model for light pollution risk at any location
Score the four land types in one province and map the risk
Propose three treatment strategies and compare them over three time horizons
Pick the best strategy for two sites and publish a flyer

section_map.summary: Urban risk 0.407, three horizons, and a different winning strategy for each.
Trespass, over-illumination, and clutter, plus the sunshade as a remedy.
Five numbered tasks ending in a flyer.
Fixed zoning, fixed elevation, and no disaster.
Shaanxi chosen for its variety, with rasters and spreadsheets from five sources.
Entropy weights feeding TOPSIS, five bands at the quintiles.
Awareness, market standards, and social monitoring, forecast over 50 years.
The reserve keeps awareness throughout; the city rotates through all three.
Crime up 2.140 percent, accidents down 2.135 percent.
Gaussian noise on night brightness leaves the scores in range.
Speak for the stars, with three ringed actions and two audiences.

contributions.summary: The weights are computed layer by layer up the hierarchy, so the interactions between elements survive.
A parcel is represented by its geometric center, and the type by the average of its centers.
An environmental red line triggers a mandatory recovery within one year.
The best strategy changes with the horizon, so the recommendation is a sequence.

dependency_graph.handoff: The proximity score is computed at each geometric center and averaged by land type.
The current risk and the indicator values are what the strategies modify.
The treatment effect per horizon decides the strategy at each site.

assumptions.summary: Land-use zoning does not change for 50 years.
No major disaster or conflict occurs.
Residents switch toward energy-saving lamps at a decaying rate.
Regulation can rebound, so the forecast needs a noise term.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Rasters of night light, GDP, population, elevation, and rainfall for Shaanxi.
Kriging interpolation from the observation stations to the 34 centers.
Biodiversity and building density read from official documents as ranges.
Lamp wattages and 2020 market shares for five lamp types.
Provincial counts of crimes and traffic accidents.

models.summary: Scores a site by entropy weighting and TOPSIS proximity.
Maps the four land types of Shaanxi from 34 geometric centers.
Forecasts 50 years and grades three strategies on three horizons.
Picks the strategy sequence for the two extreme sites and prices the side effects.

verification.summary: The weights match intuition: people and night brightness dominate.
Perturbing night brightness at both sites keeps the scores in a reasonable range.
A negative short-term effect is reported for social monitoring, so the comparison is not filtered.

results_trace.summary: Red lines at 2489, 1747, 1242, and 787 species for the four land types.
The city gets awareness, then market rules, then social monitoring, with effects 0.019, 0.025, and 0.032.
The reserve's effects stay below two ten-thousandths in every period.
Crime up 2.140 percent from 22997, accidents down 2.135 percent from 5555.

writing_logic.summary: Answer the problems in order, one paragraph each.
Follow every assumption with an explanation.
Justify each indicator by the mechanism that links it to the harm.
Say why two methods are combined before combining them.
Take the starting value of a rate from the gap in a published table.
Set a red line and state both the penalty and the deadline.
Test the strategies at the two extremes so the middle is bracketed.
Attach a remedy to each admitted weakness.

language_observations.summary: The phenomenon is given an alias, light damage, at first mention.
The combination of methods is defended by the weakness each one has.
The weight pattern is translated back into a sentence about who uses the light.
A site that does not respond is explained by what it already is.
The flyer splits its readers into business people and supervisors.

visualization_observations.summary: Figures 1 and 2 photograph over-illumination and light clutter.
Figures 3 and 4 diagram the vertical and horizontal sunshade.
Figure 5 draws the hierarchical index with the pollution forms linked in.
Figure 6 shows the entropy weighting computed layer by layer.
Figure 7 maps the four land types of Shaanxi.
Figure 9 maps brightness, GDP, population, altitude, and rainfall.
Figure 10 gives the weights at each level.
Figure 11 maps the provincial risk in 2022.
Figure 12 locates the two optimized sites.
Figures 13 to 15 plot the fifty-year forecasts.
Figures 16 to 21 compare each strategy before and after at both sites.
Figures 22 and 23 test the perturbed brightness.
The flyer centers the words speak for the stars over a city skyline.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: A judge rewards a recommendation that changes strategy as the horizon lengthens.
A judge rewards reporting the social cost, the rise in crime, beside the benefit.
A judge penalizes an evaluation whose equations print as bare numbers.

weaknesses.summary: The notation symbols were lost in extraction.
Equations 1 to 23 print as bare numbers, so the algebra is rebuilt from the prose.
The ARIMA orders and the logistic parameters are never given.
The rebound perturbation has no stated numerical bounds.
A figure caption names the wrong strategy.
The side effects are not traced to individual measures.
The strategies never interact across the three horizons.
The constants linking the treatment effect to crime and to accidents are not given.

independent_extensions.statement: Publish the ARIMA orders, the logistic parameters, and the rebound bounds, and rebuild the fifty-year paths.
independent_extensions.reason: The effects are printed to three decimals but cannot be reproduced from the given information.

independent_extensions.statement: Run the three strategies in sequence at one site and compare with the one-at-a-time results.
independent_extensions.reason: The paper itself notes that a strategy's early effect should change its later one, and never checks.

candidate_rule_impacts.impact: Supports forecasting the drivers with a logistic population and ARIMA for the rest, then rescoring every year.
Supports choosing the treatment by its average effect over a stated horizon and reporting the social cost alongside the gain.

unresolved_questions: Which ARIMA orders and logistic parameters generate the fifty-year forecasts.
What numerical bounds the rebound perturbation uses.
How large the constants are that turn the treatment effect into crime and accident changes.
